name: Compile-Time Memory Geometry Gates
description: Enforces byte size, field alignment, and natural ABI layout of all zero-copy Pod types at compile time via const assertions, preventing runtime memory corruption.
recommendations: Place const assertions verifying exact byte sizes (e.g., const _: () = assert!(core::mem::size_of::<Record>() == 256);) next to struct definitions.
Include explicit padding fields (pub _pad0: u16, pub _pad1: u32) to prevent compiler-dependent padding gaps.
Derive bytemuck::Pod and bytemuck::Zeroable rather than writing manual unsafe implementations.
